verdict.rationale: Unity has an in-editor AI Assistant, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Unity acting as an MCP server: its server lets external agents such as Claude Code and Cursor drive the Editor, and `unity mcp` is a server mode. Nothing shows the Assistant or the Editor connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools, and server-role evidence does not transfer to this client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
